title: 50TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE COMPUTER SCIENCE DEPARTMENT AT THE UNIVERSITY OF UTAH
summary: A full-day recording of the University of Utah computer science department's 50th anniversary event with panels, keynotes and talks by alumni and pioneers. It includes Ivan Sutherland's presentation on single flux quantum electronics.
why: HN points to specific segments, especially Sutherland's SFQ talk and graphics pioneers, rather than the full seven hours.

quote.text: It's a very interesting presentation, from the history to the mechanics of how it works, to the possibilities.
